summary_1line: After Sharabhanga’s ascent to heaven, diverse forest sages gather and plead with Rama to protect them from the violent persecution of demons.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sharabhanga rises from the funeral fire in a youthful radiant form while sages watch the flames of the sacrificial pyre.
Hundreds of austere sages of many practices assemble in a forest hermitage, bowing before Rama to beg for protection.
Rishis show Rama the scattered bodies of slain ascetics lying in the forest near the Mandakini river.
